summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of TAM hierarchy (parent-child nesting) feature on /thesis. All 4 deterministic flows pass: sidebar parent <select> nesting + toast + note, megatrend folder TAM aggregation excluding child, undo/redo of nesting, and caption mentioning sub-tesis exclusion. Backend was already verified by main agent; UI integration verified end-to-end via Playwright on the live preview URL with the seeded test_profile_user_123 session.

sidebar_manual_nesting.details: Parent <select data-testid=sidebar-trend-parent-thesis_test_robot> shown with option '↳ sub-tesis de: IA y centros de datos'. After selecting, PUT /api/thesis/{id}/parent fires, toast 'Sub-tesis independizada' (on clear) / nesting toast on assign, note rendered with exact text '↳ sub-tesis de «IA y centros de datos» · TAM no sumado' via data-testid sidebar-trend-parent-note-thesis_test_robot. Clearing to 'Sin madre (TAM propio)' removes the note (count=0).

treemap_tam_aggregation.details: Megatendencias view, folder 'IA & Cómputo' (folder_tam_test) badge: BEFORE nesting = '$1.1T' (1150B = 700 + 450, rendered as $1.1T per fmtTam threshold >=1000 → T). AFTER nesting robot under aidc + refresh-data-btn click = '$700B'. In Tesis view, the child cell shows text '↳ Robótica e IA física' with 'sub-tesis' badge (data-testid explore-cell-trend-thesis_test_robot).

undo_redo.details: Header undo-btn reverts nesting (folder badge back to $1.1T, sidebar note removed). Redo-btn re-applies (folder badge back to $700B). Both buttons fully integrated with assign_parent action type.

caption.details: explore-caption in Megatendencias and Tesis views contains exact string: 'El TAM de una sub-tesis (↳) no se suma al de su megatendencia para evitar el doble conteo.'

critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking): React hydration warning logged in console ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') caused by the build-time JSX source-map instrumentation injecting <span x-component> wrappers inside <option> children in ThesisSidebar.jsx parent <select>. It is purely a dev-instrumentation issue (does not affect functionality), but it spams the console on every render of TrendRow. Consider mapping options to plain text strings (already plain strings here) — the wrappers are auto-injected by the toolchain, so this may need a JSX instrumentation exclusion or wrapping the dynamic title in a comment expression to suppress.

Good: data-testid coverage is excellent on sidebar-trend-parent-<id>, sidebar-trend-parent-note-<id>, explore-cell-folder-<id>, explore-cell-trend-<id>, undo-btn/redo-btn/refresh-data-btn — easy automated testing.

Note: After nesting via sidebar, the central treemap requires a manual click on refresh-data-btn to re-fetch dashboard (the parent assignment does not auto-refresh the folder TAM in the treemap). This is documented in the request but a UX consideration — consider auto-refreshing the dashboard slice on a successful parent assignment to avoid the user having to manually refresh.
seed_data_creation: Re-asserted deterministic seed via direct Mongo upsert: folder_tam_test 'IA & Cómputo' with thesis_test_aidc (tam_busd=700, parent_id=None) and thesis_test_robot (tam_busd=450, parent_id=None). After tests, parent was cleared back to None for next runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TAM hierarchy feature is fully working end-to-end. The seed state was restored to independent (parent_id=None on both) after testing. If retesting, the badge value rendering uses fmtTam: >=1000 → $X.XT, >=10 → $XXB. 1150 → $1.1T, 700 → $700B. Treemap requires manual refresh-data-btn click after parent assignment to reflect new folder TAM.
